findings.title: Cleanup ticker changed from 10m to 1m
findings.body: The diff changes the background cleanup ticker from every 10 minutes to every 1 minute with no mention in the PR description. That runs all cleanup jobs (snapshots, versions, images, annotations, invites, short URLs, query history) 10x more often, adding significant DB and IO load. Revert to 10 minutes or justify the change separately.

findings.title: Debug logging left at Error level with full ID lists
findings.body: CleanAnnotations and CleanOrphanedAnnotationTags log every batch with r.log.Error including the full ids slice, cond and err (lines around 534, 537, 554, 557, 576, 579). On a normal run this emits Error-level logs continuously, will trip error alerting/dashboards, and for large batches (test uses 32767 IDs) dumps tens of thousands of IDs per iteration causing log volume and performance problems. These should be removed or demoted to Debug.
